# PaperDrill

> PaperDrill is a competitive trading platform where traders trade credit markets, connect bots through the API, and climb the global leaderboard.

PaperDrill runs BTC/USD, ETH/USD, and SOL/USD credit markets with price-time priority matching, persistent credit balances, and real-time market data. It is free, browser-based, and gives manual and API traders one measurable public record. Credits have no monetary value, and no real funds or assets are deposited or traded.

## Platform

- [Home](https://paperdrill.dev/): Landing page with product overview and live demo UI
- [Markets](https://paperdrill.dev/markets): Browse live spot markets and 24h stats
- [Leaderboard](https://paperdrill.dev/leaderboard): Global standings ranked by portfolio return
- [Trading Console](https://paperdrill.dev/trade/BTC_USD): Full trading UI with order book, chart, and order entry
- [Sign Up](https://paperdrill.dev/signup): Create a free account with a starting credit balance

## Developers

- [Documentation](https://docs.paperdrill.dev): How PaperDrill works — markets, trading, API overview
- [API](https://api.paperdrill.dev): REST API and WebSocket endpoints (see docs for usage)
